text:
Nina: Brainstorm: add a 'shadow-redirect' mode for rollouts that copies traffic to fallback without changing production path. Good for verifying responses during autoswitchover. Thoughts?

Omar: Love it. UI should surface it as a toggle next to presets: [shadow ON/OFF]. Show success/error divergence rate and payload diff score.

Priya: Important: shadow mode must be free of side-effects (no writes). Need to flag requests that are non-idempotent and block shadowing. Provide a warning in the console.

Nina: UX: when shadowing is active show a small live badge: "shadowing: 12s | divergence 0.3%". Click badge -> open mini-playback with two columns (prod vs fallback responses).

Omar: Telemetry: event=rollout.shadow_sample with keys [policy_id, sample_rate,divergence,trigger,event_id]. Keep it separate from normal redirect events.

DevBot: saved_policy: id=pol_1724, auto=true, modes=[normal,shadow,full], triggers=[p95>1300ms]

Priya: For overrides during shadowing require operator_note if they escalate to full redirect. Add operator field in telemetry.

Nina: Also add an autofail-safe: if divergence >5% for 3 consecutive minutes, auto-disable shadow and alert on-call.

Omar: Good. I'll add a small cost estimate for shadowing (extra tokens processed) and a quota guard so we don't accidentally double-bill customers.

Priya: I'll wire the Figma mock and include the warning flows for non-idempotent requests.

Nina: Thanks — will follow up with the PR adding policy fields: shadow_sampling, divergence_threshold, operator_note_required.

Omar: I'll make a short telemetry PR to reserve event names for shadowing and divergence alerts.
